title: Restore P1List sequence iteration
objective: Make list(P1List(N)) obey Python sequence exhaustion and preserve exact Sage-compatible indexing semantics

handoff.summary: P1List now checks normalized sequence indices before crossing the FLINT boundary, raises Python IndexError at both ends, and supports legacy __getitem__ iteration. Focused tests cover Sage's exact level-10 representatives, length, slicing, positive and negative indexing, exhaustion, and native-disabled execution.
next_steps: The integration lane should rerun the full modular-symbols suite after rebuilding its production runtime.
